selection.population: All 615 fit source-connected groups in the frozen label-free v1 prepared inputs.
selection.group_rule: Sort by sha256(UTF8(seed||str(group_id))); take the smallest 256.
selection.response_rule: Within each selected group, take the smallest sha256(UTF8(seed||str(response_id))).

extraction.views: The unchanged v1 masks 000..111 and same published answer axis.
extraction.GPU_gate: Reuse the frozen v2 WDDM process gate; write independent v3 smoke/cache/lineage.

fit_only_scoring.gold_open_time: Only the explicit score command, after all 256 GPU caches are frozen.
fit_only_scoring.folds: Fixed label-free five-fold GroupKFold over the 256 distinct source-connected groups.
fit_only_scoring.training: Lexical raw-BPE labels; same v1 group/answer/token weights, StandardScaler, L2 liblinear LR C=0.1.
fit_only_scoring.projection: Unified eligible stride-one 4-original-BPE windows take max lexical-token risk; answer takes max window risk.
fit_only_scoring.thresholds: Each readout chooses window and answer thresholds on its complete fit OOF predictions only.
fit_only_scoring.identity: A/B/C are internal ablations of our method, not paper baselines.
fit_only_scoring.limitations: Same OOF cohort supplies threshold choice and reporting; pilot evidence is developmental, not independent test evidence.

common_evaluation_policy.owner: Our dataset, group split, labels, 4-BPE windows, answer labels, and metrics define the common exam.
common_evaluation_policy.paper_baselines: Any future paper baseline must retain author architecture, features, training, and native readout unchanged.
common_evaluation_policy.allowed_baseline_mapping: Only predeclared parameter-free label-independent output mapping.
common_evaluation_policy.current_A_B_C: Internal method ablations; no paper baseline is run or modified here.

stage_gate: initialize -> prepare -> check -> audit; review; gpu-smoke -> extract; review; score
prohibitions: CPU stages do not read fit label files.
Calibration and official test are never addressed.
v1/v2 artifacts are read-only and never overwritten.
No baseline is modified or scored.
